Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 131. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Weapon technique
Ki Cost: 10 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Weapon
that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 reaction, when you are targeted by a
melee attack by a creature in your range.
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: No
You strike out to clash against against an incoming
attack, attempting to overpower their stance. Make a
combo attack roll, on a success you knock the target
prone.
